requirement: Delegation must name grantor, delegate, exact scope, duration, limits, and revocation terms.
default_treatment: No delegation exists unless durable written record exists.

requirement: Delegate may not expand delegation or delegate production authority unless expressly permitted by Founder instrument.
Standing alternate authority must be named for expiring certifications or the affected record suspends/narrows per its review trigger.
default_treatment: Suspend or narrow; do not silently extend.
